answer: Picture reputation as a garden: each agent stakes a refundable bond to plant one identity, and the bond required to keep a seat grows superlinearly with how many identities trace back to a single funder. A public atlas maps every identity to its funding thread, so a Sybil attacker spinning up a thousand clones pays a thousand superlinear bonds instead of one, making mass fake identities cost far more capital than the influence they could ever buy.
